reviewer_scope: Independent document and workflow validation against grading/criteria.json using only the revised staged requests, inputs, formatted outputs, execution logs, canonical PDFs and page PNGs, bundle manifests, matching bundle directories, and parent-verification-revised.json. No candidate source outside staged bundles, prior reviews or rounds, diagnosis, or intended fix was inspected. Run-log PASS statements were independently checked. This review does not certify scientific correctness, statistical validity, accessibility, journal compliance, or Microsoft Word rendering parity.

pages_inspected.reason: No formatted output is expected under the required safe-stop path.

criteria.evidence: Independent DOCX comparison found identical ordered w:t sequences (P01: 299 nodes; P02: 188), document-level paragraph text/order, canonical XML for all table-external body elements (6 per case), sectPr, table counts/dimensions (P01 74x4; P02 2x2), physical-cell counts, and merge signatures. P03 produced no output and its input SHA-256 remains e7b80c318e311100a20a3314dc3fd92141ba41a44ba03aad575d15efb96269cb.

P01 renders to 5 Letter pages. PDF extraction and visual inspection found the complete two-row header on every page and continuous nonduplicated row IDs: R001-R013, R014-R028, R029-R043, R044-R058, and R059-R072. OOXML has tblHeader on rows 1 and 2 only.

P01 visually has top and header-bottom rules on each fragment, the final bottom rule after R072, and no vertical/internal grid, diagonal/double rules, or shading. OOXML has only 11 non-nil cell rules: three 1 pt top, four 0.5 pt header-bottom, and four 1 pt final-bottom rules; shading is clear/FFFFFF.

All five P01 pages were inspected at original resolution. No clipping, overlap, missing glyphs, blank continuation page, or excessive gap was visible; extracted rows are complete and continuous through R072, and the final note/sentinel are visible.
P01 and P02 captions are directly above their table starts on page 1. Their notes and sentinels follow the final data and final bottom rule on P01 page 5 and P02 page 4, with clear ownership.

P02's single 180-paragraph body row is taller than one page. Independent OOXML inspection found cantSplit on the header but not the body row, matching the documented justified splitting exception. Four-page rendering preserves all content through TOKEN-180 plus the note and sentinel.

All four canonical P02 PNGs were independently inspected. Visible ranges are continuous (001-044, 045-096, 097-148, 149-180). Input/output DOCX each contain exactly 180 unique tokens in exact order; PDF extraction contains all 180 once and the final sentinel. The log limits visual PASS to the four inspected pages.

P03 input explicitly identifies the only 3x2 table as an author-information layout container. The log classifies it out of scope, specifies a title-page/author-information layout workflow, and safely stops. formatted.docx is absent and the input hash is unchanged.

All coordinator and run bundle trees contain exactly the four manifest-listed files, and every hash matches. No extra/missing files, cache/log/intermediate files, checklist.md, or F01/F20 text were found.

P01 and P02 record the required runtime, concrete commands/exit results, hashes, renderer/page counts, separate structure/visual findings, and non-certification boundaries. P03 records versions, input hash, justified N/A output/render fields, and separate sections, but abbreviates its key read-only DOCX/XML inspection as "$CODEX_PRIMARY_RUNTIME_PYTHON -B - <<'PY' ... PY". The actual here-document body is omitted, so the actual command is not recorded.

Every criterion was decidable from the staged requests, logs, outputs, manifests, independent structural checks, and canonical page images without diagnosis or intended-fix material. The R10 defect is directly visible in the P03 log.

limitations: Visual findings are specific to the supplied LibreOffice/Poppler canonical renders and do not guarantee identical pagination in every Microsoft Word version.
The review is limited to document/workflow behavior and does not assess scientific meaning, statistical correctness, accessibility, or journal-specific compliance.
Bundle purity was verified from manifest-matched final trees and recorded -B/post-run checks; an already-deleted transient file cannot be reconstructed from staged evidence.
